errors.evidence: The figure caption states 'Ausfuhrüberschuss' (export surplus), not 'Exporte' (exports). This changes the fundamental meaning of what is being plotted.

errors.text_span: mit gleichmäßigen Intervallen von einem Jahr
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are placed every six months (e.g., 07/2014, 01/2015, 07/2015), not every year.

errors.text_span: Die linke y-Achse ist mit „monatlich“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The label 'monatlich (linke Achse)' refers to the purple line series, not the axis itself. The axis has no direct label, but its unit 'Mrd. US-$' is shown at the top.
The range of the left y-axis extends down to -50, it is not from 0 to 200.

errors.text_span: Die rechte y-Achse ist mit „Summe der zurückliegenden zwölf Monate“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The label 'Summe der zurückliegenden zwölf Monate (rechte Achse)' refers to the blue line series, not the axis itself. The axis has no direct label, but its unit 'Mrd. US-$' is shown at the top.

errors.text_span: fällt auf etwa 40 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2020
errors.evidence: The purple line drops sharply in early 2020 to a value below zero, approximately -20 billion US-$, not 40 billion US-$.

errors.text_span: beginnend bei etwa 1.200 Milliarden US-Dollar im Juli 2014
errors.evidence: The blue line begins at approximately 1,000 billion US-$ in July 2014, not 1,200 billion US-$.

errors.text_span: schwankt dann bis etwa 1.600 Milliarden US-Dollar im Dezember 2019
errors.evidence: The value of the blue line around December 2019 / January 2020 is approximately 1,100 billion US-$, not 1,600 billion US-$.

errors.text_span: fällt auf etwa 800 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2020
errors.evidence: The blue line represents a 12-month rolling sum and is much smoother than the monthly data. It does not experience a sharp drop in February 2020 and never reaches a value as low as 800 billion US-$. Its value in early 2020 is over 1,000 billion US-$.
